title: BBQN Iftar Fest - Ramadan Special
description_text:
On the occasion of Ramadan, we celebrated the Barbeque Nation Iftar Fest with underprivileged children from NGOs across five cities—Bengaluru, New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, and Hyderabad—in a special initiative as part of our Ramadan Extravaganza food festival.

More than 200 children from partner NGOs like @hopeforlifefoundation403  and @buildingblocksin  Bengaluru, @RobinHoodArmy.  -Mumbai and Kolkata,  @khushiyaanfoundation9655 - Delhi, and Hope for Life Foundation- Hyderabad, were hosted to a warm Iftar in the Barbeque Nation restaurants.

It was a heartwarming experience filled with fun activities, delicious treats and lots of laughter! 

In this moment of shared joy and heartfelt connection, we rediscovered the beauty and happiness of coming together as one.

description_text:
About “Pukar Waqt Ki”

Having a dream of serving the society, Our Founder, Dr. Kirti Gupta, started
a social firm by the name “Pukar Apno Ke Sapno Ki” in the year 2014, which
worked on the upliftment of Social, Educational and Health status of the
underserved section of society for around 120+ nedy children.

The same was registered as an NGO in the year 2016 by the name “Pukar Waqt
Ki”.

”Pukar Waqt Ki” Team of 50+ volunteer Teachers has touched the lives of
150+ needy children of Karnal city.

The NGO provides Free of cost Coachings to 120+ students and also takes
care of the Monetary Help, Stationary needs, Medical needs, food and every
other sort of help which is possible.

FREE Complete Schooling and Professional Coachings has been sponsored
for 45+ students so far.

Students are also enrolled in various co-curricular activities including
sports, dance, music and craft.

NGO has also organised-

• Cloth Donation Drive for the Slums of Karnal

• Dental Screening and First ever Free of cost Dental Treatment Camp for
the Residents of Karnal.

• *Pukar Hunar Haat*, Handicraft Exhibition at Hotel Jewels, Karnal during
Diwali Fest organiser by AIVBC Trust, Karnal.

And various other major projects.
